name: Tiger
author: Alkatraz
description: Hit the blue orb at 3% as late as possible, then click exactly how the video shows in the UFO part following to skip the cube portal. Avoid all portals after this to stay upside down (I recommend pausing so you don't accidently hit any of the portals) and go under the saw at 6%. Spam under the gear wall at 31% and let go at 32%. After that do 2 clicks at 63% to fall down to the floor, spam at 78.5% until 80% to go over a maze, and finally go over the 2 block pillar at 98% to complete the level.
